info.name: Billing — Plans
info.description:
Billing plans API (`/api/v1/billing-plan`) — what dooit sells and clients buy.

**Access model**

| | dooit | client |
|---|---|---|
| list / get | every plan, incl. drafts | **published only**, public or granted |
| create / edit / publish / version / archive / delete | yes | **403** |
| eligibility (grant / revoke / list) | yes | **403** |

A client who guesses a private `planId` gets **404**, not 403 — existence is
not disclosed.

**Immutability** — a published plan is frozen. Editing returns 409; the path
forward is `POST /:id/new-version`, which clones it to a draft. Publishing the
new version archives the old one automatically.

## Setup
1. Set `URL` (default `http://localhost:6830`).
2. Run **Auth → Login (dooit)** and **Login (client)**.
3. Run **Setup → Pick a product** — captures `{{productId}}`, needed to create a plan.
4. Run the **Lifecycle** folder in order for a full draft → publish → version → archive pass.

Every request asserts its status, so the collection runs as a smoke suite:

```
newman run BillingPlans.postman_collection.json --env-var URL=http://localhost:6830
```

Companion: `BillingProducts.postman_collection.json`.
Reference: docs/billingmodule/mongoose-schema.md
